crossRefs.note: They each caught his opponent by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together…
When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,
the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
